results.Summary: Write original descriptions from extracted, verified source facts.
results.Limitations: Does not independently publish; checks accuracy, originality and description rules.
results.Output: Vetted description drafts with supporting source citations.
results.When to assign: For original sourced descriptions; hand drafts to the responsible reviewer or publisher.
results.Name: geo-describe

results.Summary: Recompose an input image into a 2364 × 640 banner.
results.Limitations: Optional media workflow; tools and image must be available.
results.When to assign: Optional for a content agent assigned banner/image preparation; not required for text or claim work.
results.Trigger: make a banner; wide image; target 2364x640
results.Name: image-banner-recompose

results.Summary: Detect content-stream coverage, depth, freshness, structural and thematic gaps.
results.Limitations: Version history records SDK migration debt in the publication branch; revalidate before execution.
results.Output: Ranked gap findings and a reviewed publish package.
results.When to assign: For assigned gap discovery. Revalidate documented publication-path limitations before executing any writes.
results.Name: geo-discovery

results.Summary: Implement field-level approvals, explicit mappings, three-way conflict checks and safe reconciliation.
results.Limitations: Implemented inside geo-mirror, not as a separate skill. Works on any Notion table with a Geo ID column: publishes approved proposals (Proposed … columns) or edited mirrored text columns, after live per-space checks (stale, fallback, QA-flagged, other-space rows are skipped). Not yet covered: relation and hierarchy proposals, new entities, intentional clears (use geo-publish); approval is per row, not per field; transaction IDs are not written back to Notion.
results.Output: A tested reusable capability satisfying the linked design contract.
results.When to assign: Publishing reviewed changes from any mirrored Notion table back to Geo.
results.Trigger: Needed when the linked workflow is implemented.
results.Name: Conflict-aware Notion → Geo publisher

results.Summary: Translate editorial intent into a scoped query and publication plan.
results.Limitations: Routes to underlying skills; does not remove their safeguards.
results.Output: A plan, generated script, dry run and routed execution.
results.When to assign: For coordinating assigned graph operations. It routes underlying skills and does not grant additional authority.
results.Trigger: bulk update; assign; combine Geo operations
results.Name: geo-orchestrate

results.Summary: Distill an editor’s day into a confirmed Notion report.
results.Limitations: Reads Claude Code work; other work needs top-up. Requires report confirmation and correct identity.
results.Output: A reviewed daily report under the editor’s identity.
results.When to assign: Only for an assigned editor daily-report workflow; confirm the reporting identity and follow the skill's draft-confirmation requirement. Not a universal agent dependency.
results.Name: daily-report

results.Summary: Find and retrieve scoped Geo content with server filters, schema inspection and complete pagination.
results.Limitations: Installed guidance needs current corrections for epoch-string createdAt and Datetime source publication.
results.Output: Scoped results with IDs, provenance and coverage.
results.When to assign: For direct graph retrieval or verification. Optional for project management only when the task requires direct graph evidence.
results.Used by: ["Content agents","Data and schema agents","Quality review agents"]
results.Trigger: look up entities; query a space; inspect relations
results.Name: geo-query

results.Summary: Create or update Geo entities and relations with schema, duplicate, dry-run and verification checks.
results.Limitations: Requires task-specific scope, authorization and signer setup; not invoked by this catalog task.
results.Output: Recorded operations, proposals, receipts and verified indexed results.
results.When to assign: For the explicitly assigned graph writer with verified access, exact destinations and applicable authorization. Optional for a content agent also assigned this role.
results.Name: geo-publish

results.Summary: Discover and repair duplicate, orphan, datatype and relation problems.
results.Limitations: Protect ranked, anchored, system and voting data; special destructive gates remain applicable.
results.Output: Discovery evidence and guarded repair operations.
results.When to assign: Only for assigned data repair, movement or deduplication; retain its operation-specific safeguards.
results.Trigger: find duplicates; merge; clean up; move or copy
results.Name: geo-clean

results.Summary: Adjudicate claim pairs, establish Related claims and assign exact relation brackets.
results.Limitations: Keyword similarity is candidate retrieval only. Apply the installed two-step bracket rubric.
results.Output: Pair decisions, reasons, group structure and controlled relation operations.
results.When to assign: For claim-pair analysis and relation proposals. Publication stages require the assigned writer's capabilities and task authorization.
results.Trigger: group claims; duplicate or similar claims; claim brackets
results.Name: geo-claim-grouping

results.Summary: Reconcile approved Notion and local file revisions using stable keys, baselines and conflict checks.
results.Limitations: Requirement only. No new skill installed or production implementation claimed.
results.Output: A tested reusable capability satisfying the linked design contract.
results.When to assign: Proposed library-maintenance automation only; do not treat the catalog entry as an available sync tool.
results.Trigger: Needed when the linked workflow is implemented.
results.Name: Agent document revision sync

results.Summary: Make target ownership, dependency receipts and interrupted-work recovery consistent.
results.Limitations: Requirement only. No new skill installed or production implementation claimed.
results.Output: A tested reusable capability satisfying the linked design contract.
results.When to assign: Proposed automation only. Every agent follows the shared coordination document; this uninstalled skill is not required to do so.
results.Trigger: Needed when the linked workflow is implemented.
results.Name: Agent coordination and handoff

results.Summary: Create linked Notion mirrors and support a reviewed return-path workflow.
results.Limitations: Notion → Geo works for text fields on any Notion table with a Geo ID column (plan-notion-changes.mjs plans, sync-to-geo.mjs publishes). Relation proposals and new entities go through geo-publish.
results.Output: Identity-linked databases, field mappings and mirror evidence.
results.When to assign: For assigned Notion mirrors or refreshes; verify supported fields, conflict handling and the actual return path.
results.Trigger: mirror to Notion; refresh; sync reviewed edits
results.Name: geo-mirror

results.Summary: Compare external coverage with scoped Geo news and recommend missing stories.
results.Limitations: Read-only; external search coverage is not exhaustive.
results.Output: Already-covered and not-yet-covered findings with verified links.
results.When to assign: For external coverage comparison and source discovery; read-only results support editorial proposals.
results.Trigger: press review; what news is missing; find sources
results.Name: geo-press-review

results.Summary: Interpret entity types, properties and relations against the ontology and live graph.
results.Limitations: Advice does not publish. Confirm live definitions before using them.
results.Output: Read-only modelling advice and proposed definitions.
results.When to assign: For entity-type, property and relation interpretation; read-only advice does not itself publish changes.
results.Used by: ["Content agents","Data and schema agents","Quality review agents"]
results.Trigger: how to model; choose a type; inspect schema
results.Name: ontology-advisor

results.Summary: Runs the whole Geo → Notion → claim-grouping pipeline from one request instead of eight separate steps.
results.Limitations: Composes the other skills; the same approval rules apply to anything it would publish.
results.Output: Refreshed mirror plus grouping review columns, with the per-step evidence.
results.When to assign: One request covering mirror refresh plus claim grouping.
results.Trigger: mirror and group; run the pipeline
results.Name: geo-mirror-and-group

results.Summary: How to read and write Notion correctly from this toolkit: which identity to use, the API limits, and the behaviours that bite.
results.Limitations: Guidance plus toolkit scripts; it does not itself mirror or publish content.
results.Output: Correct, rate-limited Notion reads and writes.
results.When to assign: Any task that touches Notion through the toolkit rather than the connector.
results.Trigger: read/write Notion; Notion API limits; which token to use
results.Name: notion-operations

results.Summary: Write claim-grouping results into a Notion Claims mirror as review columns, instead of publishing relations to Geo.
results.Limitations: Writes Notion only. Publishing the accepted relations to Geo is a separate, gated step.
results.Output: Grouping results as review columns in the Notion Claims mirror.
results.When to assign: Claim grouping that should be reviewed in Notion before anything reaches Geo.
results.Trigger: group claims into Notion; grouping review columns
results.Name: geo-claim-grouping-notion

properties.Done when: All applicable child steps meet their completion criteria; remaining exceptions are recorded.
properties.Failure response: Follow the affected step’s recovery guidance and keep dependent writes blocked.
properties.Name: Publish reviewed Notion changes to Geo
properties.Summary: Map and validate explicit editorial changes, submit authorized operations and verify the result.

properties.Done when: Each field has a current decision and defined intended value.
properties.Failure response: Exclude unreviewed, ambiguous and unsupported fields.
properties.Name: Select reviewed proposed fields
properties.Summary: Select explicit field-level proposals and their review decisions; distinguish clears from blanks.

properties.Done when: No write authority is inferred from first space membership.
properties.Failure response: Stop unresolved destinations.
properties.Name: Resolve explicit write destinations
properties.Summary: Map every proposal to Geo entity, property/relation and destination space IDs.

properties.Done when: Every touched assertion is scoped to its destination.
properties.Failure response: Do not publish against a stale or failed read.
properties.Name: Re-read current Geo values
properties.Summary: Fetch fresh touched values and relevant relation endpoints.

properties.Done when: Concurrent changes are resolved per field.
properties.Failure response: Retain conflict evidence and defer affected operations.
properties.Name: Detect three-way conflicts
properties.Summary: Compare baseline, current Notion and current Geo, including pending editor changes.

properties.Done when: New entities and relationships are justified.
properties.Failure response: Reuse correct identities or leave ambiguous matches for review.
properties.Name: Check ontology and semantic duplicates
properties.Summary: Validate type/property meaning and exact/semantic duplicate candidates.

properties.Done when: Every operation has valid identity, type and datatype.
properties.Failure response: Reject invalid or unmapped operations.
properties.Name: Validate types and relation identities
properties.Summary: Check datatypes, required Types relations, edge IDs versus relation-entity IDs and supported fields.

properties.Done when: The package exposes exact targets, changes and limitations.
properties.Failure response: Fix dry-run failures before requesting missing approval.
properties.Name: Prepare concrete dry run
properties.Summary: Generate readable before/after operations from a separate decisions dataset; include hashes and counts.

properties.Done when: All applicable approval requirements are satisfied.
properties.Failure response: Ask for the specific missing approval with the governing rule.
properties.Name: Resolve applicable approval
properties.Summary: Attach the user’s valid authorization to the exact dry-run scope and fulfill required gates.

properties.Done when: Before-values still match and no conflicting writer owns the scope.
properties.Failure response: Regenerate the diff and re-resolve changed approval scope.
properties.Name: Recheck freshness and ownership
properties.Summary: Re-read touched assertions and writer ownership immediately before submission.

properties.Done when: Submission identities and response state are recorded.
properties.Failure response: Resolve uncertain submissions from receipts before any retry.
properties.Name: Submit permitted operations
properties.Summary: Use the compatible SDK and destination signer; record each submission before continuing.

properties.Done when: The intended proposal executed or a pending/failure state is explicit.
properties.Failure response: Report pending governance without claiming completion.
properties.Name: Verify governance execution
properties.Summary: Inspect proposal and transaction status separately from submission acknowledgment.

properties.Done when: The intended values and relationships are visible and correct.
properties.Failure response: Investigate lag or mismatch; do not resubmit blindly.
properties.Name: Verify indexed graph values
properties.Summary: Read scoped graph assertions after execution and compare values and affected relation endpoints.

properties.Done when: Fulfilled proposals are accounted for without erasing concurrent edits.
properties.Failure response: Leave conflicts visible for field-level resolution.
properties.Inputs: Verified indexed state and current Notion
properties.Name: Reconcile fulfilled mirror proposals
properties.Summary: Refresh verified Geo-backed fields and mark only matching fulfilled proposals; preserve new edits.

properties.Done when: All applicable child steps meet their completion criteria; remaining exceptions are recorded.

properties.Done when: All applicable child steps meet their completion criteria; remaining exceptions are recorded.
properties.Failure response: Follow the affected step’s recovery guidance and keep dependent writes blocked.
properties.Name: Inspect and repair graph data
properties.Summary: Discover precise quality defects and apply only guarded, authorized repairs.

properties.Done when: Each target has the expected space membership and type.
properties.Failure response: Return ambiguity or access failure rather than substituting a fuzzy match.
properties.Name: Resolve supplied identities
properties.Summary: Resolve exact entity and space URLs; use established canonical IDs and verify unfamiliar names.

properties.Done when: The entry shape is named, and the selection is explicit about two things a page or id-list mirror routinely hits: mixed entity types in one collection, and items resident in other spaces. Both are kept deliberately, not by accident.
properties.Failure response: Resolve missing scope before exporting. A whole-type or whole-space run with no scope is refused by design. If no entry shape fits the request, say what is missing and stop — never hand-roll a mirror script.
properties.Inputs: Mirror request. One of: a space and primary type; an id list (a curated tab or review set); or a Geo page whose Data blocks hold Collection item relations, read with extract-page-collections.mjs — one Notion database per collection.
properties.Name: Define mirror selection
properties.Summary: Settle which of the three entry shapes the request is — space + primary type, an explicit id list, or one Geo page's collections — then specify the related population, date meaning and fields.

properties.Done when: Selection and write destinations are explicit.
properties.Failure response: Clarify materially different candidate scopes.
properties.Name: Choose grouping scope
properties.Summary: Define space, tab or seed claims and any permitted cross-space candidate pool.

properties.Done when: Meaning is grounded in actual content.
properties.Failure response: Retrieve missing source passages before strong judgments.
properties.Name: Read content and neighborhood
properties.Summary: Inspect claim text, entity definitions, relevant relations and source context.

properties.Done when: Candidates retain IDs, types, memberships and backlinks.
properties.Failure response: Do not merge merely because names match.
properties.Name: Find exact-name duplicate candidates
properties.Summary: Group scoped entities by exact normalized identity signals without deciding semantic equivalence.

properties.Done when: Every requested field has a supported query shape and meaning.
properties.Failure response: Correct the query against live schema; do not interpret errors as empty data.
properties.Name: Inspect live schema
properties.Summary: Read relevant types, properties, datatypes and relation definitions.

properties.Done when: Root and required nested counts reconcile.
properties.Failure response: Hold writes if retrieval is incomplete.
properties.Name: Retrieve complete source snapshot
properties.Summary: Run the scoped query workflow and preserve raw values and edges.

properties.Done when: Pairs have stable IDs and traceable retrieval signals.
properties.Failure response: Report search coverage; do not call candidates equivalent.
properties.Name: Generate candidate pairs
properties.Summary: Use batched exact, keyword and semantic signals; preserve verified types and memberships.

properties.Done when: The interpretation preserves qualifiers and uncertainty.
properties.Failure response: Mark ambiguous attribution or scope.
properties.Name: Extract proposition commitments
properties.Summary: Identify what is asserted, by whom, with which strength, scope and conditions.

properties.Done when: Accepted duplicates denote the same thing.
properties.Failure response: Retain distinct meanings and uncertain cases.
properties.Name: Find semantic duplicate candidates
properties.Summary: Compare meaning, context and source evidence across near matches.

properties.Done when: The selected time answers the requested question.
properties.Failure response: Clarify or inspect history if membership time is required.
properties.Name: Define time semantics
properties.Outputs: Explicit date field and half-open bounds
properties.Summary: Choose entity creation, source publication or membership history; write timezone and boundaries.

properties.Done when: Every mirrored field has a source and supported representation.
properties.Failure response: Mark unsupported or lossy fields; do not invent a round-trip mapping.
properties.Name: Map graph fields to Notion
properties.Summary: Map Geo identities, field datatypes and relation kinds to Notion property IDs; label provenance.

properties.Done when: Comparisons preserve scope, polarity and modality.
properties.Failure response: Mark insufficient context as uncertain.
properties.Name: Read propositions and context
properties.Summary: Extract commitments, qualifiers, conditions and relevant source context for both claims.

properties.Done when: Each topic is substantively about the claim.
properties.Failure response: Avoid lexical-only assignments and unjustified new topics.
properties.Name: Assign relevant topics
properties.Summary: Link what the proposition concerns using existing topic meanings; separate topic from stance.

page_fetches.title: Inspect missing types and blank values

properties.Done when: Each defect refers to a real eligible entity.
properties.Failure response: Exclude system bookkeeping and distinguish empty from intentional values.
properties.Name: Inspect missing types and blank values
properties.Summary: Identify real untyped entities or missing requested properties, separating stubs and system entities.

properties.Done when: Count query succeeded with the intended filters.
properties.Failure response: Preserve GraphQL/network errors and retry with bounded backoff.
properties.Name: Count scoped entities
properties.Summary: Use a server-filtered count connection before hydrating a large population.

properties.Done when: All destination rows are indexed without duplicate Geo IDs.
properties.Failure response: Resolve duplicate identities before upserting.
properties.Name: Read destination identity index
properties.Outputs: Existing row index and edit baseline
properties.Summary: Read the destination IDs and current editorial fields once per database.

properties.Done when: Every retrieved pair has a reasoned decision.
properties.Failure response: Return uncertain cases for review rather than forcing a bracket.
properties.Name: Adjudicate every candidate
properties.Summary: Apply the installed rubric and record accepted, rejected or uncertain decisions with reasons.

properties.Done when: Support and opposition are explained by content.
properties.Failure response: Do not infer contradiction from difference alone.
properties.Name: Assess support and contradiction
properties.Summary: Test reasons and incompatible commitments under comparable conditions.

properties.Done when: Each candidate is a verified structural defect.
properties.Failure response: Do not remove valid repeated cross-space assertions.
properties.Name: Inspect stale and duplicate edges
properties.Summary: Find broken targets and redundant same-space edges while preserving different relation kinds.

properties.Done when: Selection matches requested constraints.
properties.Failure response: Narrow an unexpectedly broad query before hydrating.
properties.Name: Retrieve candidate identities
properties.Summary: Apply type, space, property and relation filters to retrieve candidate IDs.

properties.Done when: No unsynced proposal or review value is overwritten.
properties.Failure response: Leave conflicts unresolved with before/after evidence.
properties.Name: Compare baseline and current values
properties.Outputs: Safe refresh diff and conflict list
properties.Summary: Compare saved baseline, current Notion and current Geo; isolate conflicts and editor changes.

properties.Done when: Every link is justified as related under the rubric.
properties.Failure response: Reject accidental cross-group connections.
properties.Name: Establish Related claim groups
properties.Summary: Build the initial Related claims structure from accepted adjudications.

properties.Done when: Practical current decisions mapped to coherent 2–4-claim collections; relevant existing claims and important gaps identified; participant positions sourced.
properties.Failure response: Keep inferred positions explicitly tentative.
properties.Name: Map positions and participants
properties.Summary: Connect debate questions, positions, explicit participant commitments and evidence.

properties.Done when: Conversions are loss-aware and supported.
properties.Failure response: Escalate unparseable values instead of coercing silently.
properties.Name: Inspect datatype mismatches
properties.Summary: Compare stored values with declared property datatypes and parseability.

properties.Done when: Page flags end and counts reconcile.
properties.Failure response: Stop on repeated cursor or missing response path and record partial coverage.
properties.Name: Paginate root results
properties.Summary: Advance cursors until no more pages; track unique IDs and cursor progress.

properties.Done when: Every intended entity has one destination row.
properties.Failure response: Recover uncertain creates by identity lookup before retry.
properties.Name: Create or resolve rows
properties.Summary: Create only missing identities and update permitted row fields in combined patches.

properties.Done when: Each bracket satisfies its strict definition.
properties.Failure response: Leave related-only where a stricter bracket is unsupported.
properties.Name: Assign exact brackets
properties.Summary: Assign Duplicate, Similar or Supporting/Opposing argument relations only after established grouping.

properties.Done when: Important gaps or weak fits addressed inline; every PROPOSED row links its closest existing claims; new commitments distinguished from wording alternatives and inverses.
properties.Failure response: Remove unsupported claims and retain uncertainty.
properties.Name: Draft new claims or wording
properties.Outputs: Original and proposed wording with rationale
properties.Summary: Compose self-contained propositions from evidence while preserving original meaning or labeling new commitments.

properties.Done when: Canonical choice respects all protected cases.
properties.Failure response: Apply both-scored and other required escalation gates.
properties.Name: Select canonical identities
properties.Summary: Apply the installed deterministic canonical selection cascade and explain overrides.

properties.Done when: Required nested collections are complete.
properties.Failure response: Reduce root page size for nested data and resume recorded cursors.
properties.Name: Hydrate required values and edges
properties.Outputs: Scoped values and full edge records
properties.Summary: Batch selected entities and paginate required nested relations; retain source-space provenance.

properties.Done when: All endpoints resolve and mapped relations match.
